verdict.rationale: Omnara is an agent platform, so starting a coding task from an issue or ticket is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no documented way to assign a task to an agent from an issue or ticket. Adding a Linear MCP server only gives a running agent tools to reach Linear, which is a building block rather than issue-to-agent assignment, and the Slack connector is a chat channel, not an issue tracker.

support.subject: As a developer, I can assign a coding task to an agent directly from an existing issue or ticket
